purpose: 最小可比较记录；每个 fixture 至少有 no_assistance 实测，其余臂可在 STORY-02/03 回放

arms.no_assistance: 严格 MDX 编译，不调用 checker/formatter/Codex
arms.enhanced_existing_codex_action: 增强现有 .openclaw-sync/docs-mdx-repair.md + workflow 的单一 Codex action
arms.checker_interception: 严格 checker 在 repair action 前拦截；不修改输入
arms.final_failure: 最终仍未通过严格 parser 或内容门禁；必须保留失败 artifact/日志

success_rate_definition: success = parser_outcome=compile_success AND content_check=pass; final_failure = parser failure after allowed attempts OR content_check=fail; checker_intercepted is a separate counted outcome; not_run is excluded from denominator
timeout_policy: 记录实际耗时和轮次；不在 STORY-01 预设 timeout/retry 数值。
